who_is_missing.question: coverage of the top 20 MTEB(Multilingual, v2) models on the image and audio boards

caveats.parameter_counts: total_params_b/active_params_b are the registry row for the model name. `google/embeddinggemma-2` is registered under several tower configurations (use_image / use_audio in mteb/models/model_implementations/google_embeddinggemma.py) and the wrapper reports the loaded towers' count at run time, but the results files record no tower config. So no size is quoted for the image or audio scores, and the post makes no size claim.
caveats.predecessor: google/embeddinggemma-300m is a text-only model and has no complete MIEB or MAEB row, so it belongs in a text comparison only.
caveats.cohort: the four-model cohort is who submitted complete results, not who can run all three; the big text models have no image or audio results at all (see who_is_missing).
